body:
kai: Heads-up — prepping new org for AcmeLabs. Need GPU entitlements, VPC peering, project tagging, and billing setup across AWS (us-west-2), GCP (us-central1), and Azure (westus2).

maria: +1. Can you list exact quota increases and who owns billing?

kai: Billing will be under acmelabs-prod (acct 912-555-003). Initial quotas: AWS 8 x p4d.24xlarge (or equivalent), GCP 8 x a2-highgpu-1g (A100) per project, Azure 8 x Standard_ND96asr_v4 (A100) per subscription. Also need additional ENI / IP addresses in us-west-2: +60 ephemeral IPs.

devon: Confirming instance families: on AWS we usually request g5.12xlarge or p4d depending on availability. For now request A100-class and 8x spare capacity.

elena: Networking notes — we need /22 for peering to customer VPN in us-west-2 and route limits bumped for 200 routes in that VPC. Also ensure NAT gateway quota and AWS Elastic IP quota.

maria: I'll draft the cloud support requests. Suggested priority: "Production onboarding - 30d SLA" and include cost center tag.

sam: Finance ok with upfront estimate. Expect monthly baseline ~ $70k for reserved capacity, add burst buffer. Need cost center tag: cost_center:acme-labs.

kai: Tagging / IAM plan: create projects: acme-prod, acme-staging, acme-dev. Required tags: ["team:acme", "env:prod/staging/dev", "cost_center:acme-labs", "owner:platform"]. IAM: grant infra-service-account (svc-infra@redwood) Owner on projects, and acme-sre role (least privilege) for oncall.

maria: Draft request for GCP support (snippet):

```
Subject: Quota increase request - acmelabs-prod projects
Project IDs: acme-prod, acme-staging
Region: us-central1
Requested Quotas: GPU A100 1g: +8
Reason: Production inference fleet for new customer onboarding. Estimated sustained usage: 16k GPU-hours/mo
Contact: maria@redwood.com, kai@redwood.com
Priority: Production onboarding
```

devon: For AWS quota request, include limits: EC2 EFA, ENI, Elastic IPs, and service quota for p4d.24xlarge (per region) + request AZ diversity.

elena: Also request increased VPC route table entries and NAT gateway quotas. Some clouds require business justification — include our SLA and committed spend.

infra-bot: Created ticket INFRA-2024 for AWS quota increases, INFRA-2025 for GCP, linked to acme-prod in ops console.

maria: I'll submit all three requests this afternoon and ping account reps. Will post support case numbers here when created.

kai: One more — please add fallback region plan: if us-west-2 can't provide p4d we should fallback to us-east-1 and enable cross-region replication for model artifacts. Note latency implications.

sam: Finance note: Approve provisional reserved capacity up to $100k/mo for first 3 months — we'll reconcile actual usage.

maria: Done — AWS case #1234567890, GCP case #9876543210, Azure case #AZ-445566. Case descriptions include tags and billing account.

devon: Thanks — I'll follow up with a runbook for cross-region failover and tag propagation.

elena: I'll file a network change request once quotas are approved.

kai: Great work team. Once quotas are in we schedule onboarding checklist call. :+1:
